repositories.name: Kite Pack

Release v0.1.0 ships PPSSPP-NX2.nro with an experimental GameShare guest mode; upstream reports console-tested menu, controls and Tekken gameplay with JIT and audio, but sustained speed remains unqualified, touch/rumble/camera/microphone/HTTPS are not implemented, and no PSP games or firmware are included. This is a Switch homebrew NRO, not a PS5 ELF payload.
repositories.author: XITRIX

repositories.name: Luac0re
repositories.description: Archived research project and mast1c0re variant for PS4 and PS5 that uses the console's embedded Lua 5.3 interpreter to simplify PS2-emulator exploit development instead of PS2SDK shellcode. From version 2.0 it adds a JIT compiler exploit which upstream reports enables arbitrary native userland code execution on current PS4/PS5 firmware without a kernel exploit and bypasses the PS5 8.00+ non-AF_UNIX socket restriction; the poopsploit path still requires PS5 12.00 or lower. Requires a legally owned copy of Star Wars Racer Revenge (CUSA03474/CUSA03492) and mandatory resigning of the included savedata image. Stable 2.4b is a ZIP package, not a direct ELF payload.
repositories.author: Gezine

repositories.name: NoUpdate
repositories.description: PS5 payload that removes the "Update Required" launch restriction on installed games after an accidental online connection or a detected/partially downloaded game update. It scans installed titles automatically (no per-game patching), applies a temporary in-memory patch to the update checks and, where needed, makes backed-up persistent metadata changes that can survive a reboot. Manual launch only; no autostart, and this build disables the old OnionHEN autostart marker. A one-time console restart is required after first activation; re-launch to reapply the temporary patch (no restart needed after each launch). Targeted firmware range 6.xx–13.60 in code, but tested only on firmware 10.01 — other versions unverified. For offline single-player use on your own console; removing the prompt does not add missing firmware features or guarantee game compatibility. Stable v1.0.0; source GPL-3.0 (C#).
repositories.author: zerodayofficial

repositories.name: Longshot Plus
repositories.description: Unofficial fork of heydemoura/PS5_Longshot that builds a native PS5 port of Longshot, the static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, as title PPSA99198 on Mesa RADV from PS5_Vulkan. Release notes for v0.3.0-plus report hardware testing on PS5 Fat/Slim and PS5 Pro with 4-tier memory management and FSR 4.1.2/3.1; v0.3.2-plus adds a real-time clock, a PS5 Pro renderer profile (3.5 GiB budget, 1024-texel texture retention), A64_SUB_V, an RDNA2 atomic hang fix and FSR 3.1 direct output. Releases ship only a desktop Builder (Windows ZIP or Linux AppImage) that creates the title folder from your own game dump and .nup ROM; no game files, no ready-made title and no direct ELF asset. Back up /data/homebrew/PPSA99198/user/ and clear cache/ and radv-shader-cache/ before upgrading.
repositories.author: groovy2312

repositories.name: PSWloader
repositories.description: Payload that boots a custom EDK2 UEFI firmware on the PS5 so stock Windows 11 runs directly on the console hardware with no virtual machine and PatchGuard left on: all 8 cores/16 threads, AMD Oberon GPU with DirectX 11/12, Vulkan and OpenGL 4.6, HDMI output, wired Ethernet, onboard Wi-Fi 6 and USB keyboard/mouse. Requires a PS5 that can run payloads through a Payload Manager, a 16 GB or larger USB stick with the official Windows 11 ISO and an internal M.2 SSD or USB drive as the target; the author reports testing on system software 13.60. Windows runs in test-signing mode because the drivers are unsigned, so anti-cheat titles may refuse to start; Bluetooth, audio and changing resolution from Windows are not supported yet, and a restart from Windows returns to Windows rather than GameOS. Stable v1.0.4 adds PS5 Slim/Oberon Plus GPU PCI IDs plus installer and Wi-Fi fixes. The direct ELF is the PS5-side loader; the separate USB-Stick and Updater ZIPs are PC-side tools, not ELF payloads.

repositories.name: SeedSwap

repositories.name: TorBox for PS5
repositories.description: TorBox and Real-Debrid browser/downloader for jailbroken PS5. A background ELF server (port 9021) exposes a web UI on port 8080 reachable from a phone, PC or the PS5 browser via the PPSA97630 home-screen tile. It lists torrents/web/usenet items and Real-Debrid torrents/history, unrestricts hoster links, and downloads single files, all files or a ZIP to /data or USB with 1-16 Range connections, a queue and resume from .part files. Stable v1.0.0 was tested on firmware 13.60. Requires an ELF loader on port 9021; the home-screen tile also needs FTP access and ShadowMountPlus registration. API keys are stored unencrypted on the console, the web page has no password, and downloads stop in rest mode or on reboot. The release also ships ZIP packages; only torbox-ps5.elf is a direct ELF asset.
repositories.author: roieeedouek

repositories.name: GTA VI FPS Unlocker
repositories.description: Runtime ELF patch for jailbroken PS5 and PS5 Pro that unlocks GTA VI's 30 FPS cap, fixes delta-time game speed above 30 FPS and scales internal TAA2U (base PS5) or PSSR (Pro) render resolution in memory without changing game files or graphics presets. Stable v1.15 requires GTA VI v01.002.001 (PPSA01547/PPSA29660/PPSA38500) and must be loaded through PLDMGR/elfldr before starting the game; it creates /data/gtavi-unlockfps/fps.txt on first run (fps 30-120 default 60, res_pct 0 or 25-100 default 50, refresh_hz 60/120 default 60, experimental output_res 0/1440/1080 default 0, experimental pro_rt_half 0/1 default 0 on Pro, daemon 0/1) and supports auto-updates via the upstream repo.json source in PS5 Payload Manager. Kernel writes use DMAP on firmware 8.40+ and mdbg_copyin on older firmware. v1.15 adds opt-in 120 Hz flip-rate support (hardware-locked 40 FPS with fps=40, requiring forced 120 Hz output via ps-patch-system or FPS is halved), experimental output resolution and Pro half-res RT reflections; rt_reflections=0 was removed because it caused water glitches. Caveats: res_pct must stay <=67 on base PS5 and <=60 on Pro with stock RT to avoid boot OOM crashes, output_res and pro_rt_half are experimental, and sustained unlocked FPS raises CPU temperatures by 5-8 C.
